aggregate_metrics.fit_c_bridge_vs_pred: abs dev +4e-5 at every F/J (O(1/N) fit-form bias); within 1e-6 with a 1/N term

key_findings: On the uniform Wannier-Stark ladder the walk-sum certificate is sharp in rate: per-bridge N2' reproduces (2J/F)^N/N! up to (pi N/2) B(q'^2)^N, as predicted before the run.
On finite chains N2 sits 0.9-2.4 orders above the exact S up to N=60, against 102-105 orders for N1 and the paper's Sigma1; the chain ends do not move S.
N2' as written (global delta, sorted distances) loses a factor 4B(q^2) per bridge; the per-bridge statement removes it and also works for q >= 1/2.
summary.interpretation: Hypotheses 2 and 3 supported; hypothesis 1 supported except the per-bridge c relative-0.02 criterion at F/J = 32 and 100, which fails as written because of an O(1/N) fit-form offset of 4e-5 common to all forms; with a 1/N term the deviation is below 1e-6.
